messages.content:
<document id=DOC_status_glossary>
AMBER does not indicate a warning in this system. AMBER marks a record
that has completed successfully and been archived. It is raised only
after a successful run, and the on-call rota is deliberately NOT
notified; the change advisory board receives a weekly digest instead.
</document>

According to the glossary below, what does the status code AMBER mean,
and who is notified when it is raised?

response.text:
**AMBER** means a record completed successfully and was archived. It is raised only after a successful run.

The on-call rota is **not** notified. The change advisory board gets a weekly digest instead.
